stations.title: SERVER AUTHORITATIVE
stations.summary: The server owns simulation and damage.
stations.expectedResult: All clients converge on the server projectile and impact.

stations.title: CLIENT PREDICTED
stations.summary: The owning client predicts while the server validates and replicates.
stations.expectedResult: The owner receives immediate presentation and later correction if required.

stations.title: CLIENT AUTHORITATIVE
stations.summary: The client simulates and submits a bounded flight log for server validation.
stations.expectedResult: Validated segments drive authoritative damage and remote presentation.

stations.title: HIGH VELOCITY PROJECTILE
stations.summary: A fast, low-drag projectile demonstrates a flat trajectory.
stations.expectedResult: The path stays nearly level before impact.

stations.title: SUBSONIC HEAVY
stations.summary: A slower, heavier projectile exposes drag and gravity over distance.
stations.expectedResult: The path drops sooner than the high-velocity lane.

stations.title: ARROW - GRAVITY ARC
stations.summary: A low initial velocity and high drag make gravity easy to inspect.
stations.expectedResult: The projectile follows a visible arc into the target.

stations.title: CROSSWIND DRIFT
stations.summary: Constant positive-Y acceleration demonstrates environmental wind influence.
stations.expectedResult: The path bends toward positive Y before reaching the target distance.

stations.title: PENETRATION
stations.summary: A high-energy projectile uses a penetrable material response.
stations.expectedResult: The trace continues through the target with reduced energy.

stations.title: RICOCHET
stations.summary: A shallow impact angle uses the material ricochet response.
stations.expectedResult: The projectile changes direction instead of stopping.

stations.title: EMBED / SLIDE
stations.summary: A non-ricocheting projectile demonstrates terminal surface behavior.
stations.expectedResult: The projectile embeds or transitions into the configured slide response.

stations.title: HITSCAN
stations.summary: The same launch API resolves the path immediately without a projectile actor.
stations.expectedResult: The target registers an immediate hit and material response.

stations.title: RANDOM CONE SPREAD
stations.summary: Each launch samples a deterministic direction inside the configured cone.
stations.expectedResult: Repeated cycles form a distributed cone around the forward axis.

stations.title: FIXED PATTERN SPREAD
stations.summary: An authored 2D pattern produces repeatable projectile offsets.
stations.expectedResult: Every cycle reproduces the same visible pattern.

stations.title: IMPACT DETONATION
stations.summary: The explosive payload detonates on its first blocking impact.
stations.expectedResult: Blast and fragment damage originate at the impact point.

stations.title: FUSE TIMER
stations.summary: The explosive arms at launch and detonates after its configured fuse.
stations.expectedResult: Detonation occurs in flight after 0.65 seconds.

stations.title: DETONATE ON REST
stations.summary: The payload waits for the projectile to settle.
stations.expectedResult: Detonation follows the transition to rest.

stations.title: MANUAL DETONATION
stations.summary: Gameplay calls Detonate after launch through the aggregate example sequence.
stations.expectedResult: The payload detonates about 0.35 seconds after launch.

stations.title: BASE LAUNCH PROFILE
stations.summary: A launch profile owns sound and an array of socket-bound Niagara effects.
stations.expectedResult: The base sound, muzzle flash, smoke, and casing effects play.

stations.title: MODIFIED LAUNCH PROFILE
stations.summary: A contributor modifier changes the resolved launch presentation.
stations.expectedResult: The modifier changes effect scale, volume, pitch, and audible radius.

stations.title: SUSTAINED SEQUENCE
stations.summary: One sequence request produces cadence-controlled launch cosmetics without individual timers.
stations.expectedResult: Launch presentation repeats at the configured sequence rate.

stations.title: COSMETICS BEYOND 100 CM NET CULL
stations.summary: Cosmetic routing is independent from actor relevancy distance.
stations.expectedResult: Remote listeners receive launch presentation while the launcher actor is culled.

stations.title: POOLED 32 PROJECTILE SPREAD
stations.summary: A 32-projectile spread exercises pooling, tracer intervals, and aggregate simulation.
stations.expectedResult: Each cycle launches 32 projectiles while the pool recovers retired actors.
